scope: bounded local chart explanation from validated replay evidence
guards: context hash is validated before explanation
declared evidence IDs must match visible/evidence rows
anchor and event/bar timestamps cannot exceed replay cutoff
missing or unsupported evidence returns fail-closed status
limitations: This is a local grounded template, not a real provider acceptance.
It does not create or persist chart overlays; overlay preview/undo remains in the renderer contract.
A full U7 gate still needs UI acceptance on a real run and a separately approved provider evaluation.
